# Character enrichment sources

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:

  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.

  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 焦# (shrink) + 石 stone → partially *submerged* rocks that shrink from view at high tide → *reef*.
堅也。从石毄聲。
As per 楚# (opposite) + 石 stone → stones set in opposition as the *foundation* of a building → *cornerstone*.
礩也。从石楚聲。
石聲。从石，學省聲。

As per 當# (fit together) + 石 stone → foundation (stone); cornerstone (upon which construction materials are fitted) → *base*; *bottom*. *Slapping sound*, *stare/glare*, and *sudden/suddenly* are borrowed meanings.
As per 義# (blade-like) + 石 stone → serrated or *sharp-edged rock* → *(rocky) shoreline*.
As per 疑# (come to a stop) + 石 stone → obstructive boulder that stops progress → *obstacle*; *hindrance*.
止也。从石疑聲。
毒石也。出漢中。从石與聲。
畾# as described in 疊 (pile) + 石 stone → *pile of stones* tumbling to the ground in sequence (compare 磊) → *roll*.
柱下石也。从石質聲。
As per 厲# (whetstone) + 石 stone (for emphasis/clarification) → *whetstone* (compare 砥) → *polish*. 礪 was devised to replace 厲.
䃺也。从石厲聲。經典通用厲。
As per 樂# (grind/continue at length) + 石 stone → *small stone*; *pebble* (← products of a long process of erosion).
小石也。从石樂聲。
As per 樊# (rough-hewn) + 石 stone → sulfur crystal of irregular shape → *mineral*. The compound 明礬 refers to alum.
As per 龍# (winding) + 石 stone → grind grain in a *mortar* with a winding motion → *grind*; *mill*.
䃺也。从石龍聲。天子之桷，椓而礱之。
As per 薄# (spread thin) + 石 stone → stone(s) extending over the ground in covering (compare 碑) → *extend* (over); *cover*.
石山也。从石嚴聲。

A depiction of a frame-shaped altar, where the *gods* *manifest* their will → *show*; *indicate*; *display*; *express*. In dual-element characters, 示 nearly always functions as a reference to supernatural forces in general.
天垂象，見吉凶，所以示人也。从二。(二，古文上字。)三垂，日月星也。觀乎天文，以察時變。示，神事也。凡示之屬皆从示。

As per 土# (pile of earth) + 示 altar/the supernatural → crowd thronging an (earthen) altar → *group of like-minded people*; (Shinto) *shrine*. Abbreviation for *company* is a Meiji-era coinage representing an extended sense of the term (group formed for a specific purpose).
地主也。从示、土。《春秋傳》曰：“共工之子句龍爲社神。”《周禮》：“二十五家爲社，各樹其土所宜之木。”
As per 勺# (rise and become evident) + 示 altar/the supernatural → (imperial) *ritual* involving the raising/invocation of all gods and ancestors in the heavens.
夏祭也。从示勺聲。
As per 巳# (descendant) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *worship* of ancestors, carried out by descendants → *enshrine*; *festival*. Also, *year* (← worship on an annual basis).
祭無已也。从示巳聲。
太原縣。从邑示聲。
夭 here an abbreviated form# of 殀 die prematurely + 示 altar/the supernatural → *calamity*; *disaster*.
天# the heavens + 示 altar/the supernatural. The compound 祆敎 (祆教) refers to Zoroastrianism, and the compound 火祆 to Ahura Mazda (God).
胡神也。从示天聲。
示# altar/the supernatural + 氏 family/clan → altar for worshiping a tutelary *earth god*. *Solely* and *only* are borrowed meanings. Distinguish 祇 from 祗.
地祇，提出萬物者也。从示氏聲。
As per 斤# (adhere) + 示 altar/the supernatural → figuratively adhere to the gods in imploring them to grant one's wishes → *pray*; *wish/hope* (for).
求福也。从示斤聲。
止# (stand straight) + 示 altar/the supernatural → tall altar → *blessings*; *good fortune*; *happiness*. Compare the abstract applications of the idea of straightness/uprightness in 是.
福也。从示止聲。
殳也。从殳示聲。或說城郭市里，高縣羊皮，有不當入而欲入者，暫下以驚牛馬曰祋。故从示、殳。《詩》曰：“何戈與祋。”
宗廟主也。《周禮》有郊、宗、石室。一曰大夫以石爲主。从示从石，石亦聲。
As per 右# (protect) + 示 altar/the supernatural → protection/*help* extended by the gods.
助也。从示右聲。
As per 犮# (split away) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *exorcise*/*drive out* evil spirits, causing them to split away → *purify*.
除惡祭也。从示犮聲。

As per 付# (set in place) 示 altar/the supernatural → ritual ancestor worship involving figurines representing the ancestral spirits → *worship one's ancestors*. Also, *entomb together* (← place figurines and other artifacts in graves and tombs along with the body of the deceased ).
後死者合食於先祖。从示付聲。
神也。从示必聲。
As per 且# (pile) + 示 altar/the supernatural → figurative pile of ancestors, associated with rituals held at an altar → *ancestor* → *grandfather*; *founder*.
始廟也。从示且聲。
As per 氐# (low) + 示 altar/the supernatural → reverence for a tutelary, subterranean god (compare 祇) → *respectful*; *ceremonious*.
敬也。从示氐聲。
明視以筭之。从二示。《逸周書》曰：“士分民之祘。均分以祘之也。”读若筭。
As per 乍# (create a pile) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *happiness* or *blessings* likened to a pile of presents rendered by the throne (and sanctioned by the heavens) → *imperial status/the throne*.
福也。从示乍聲。
去# withdraw + 示 altar/the supernatural → cause unwelcome spirits to withdraw → *exorcise* (and thereby *purify*) → *expel*.
古# old + 示 altar/the supernatural → *prosperity* and *happiness* bestowed by the heavens (accruing from proper veneration of ancestors).
上諱。
As per 兄# (extend the arms in prayer) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *offer a prayer at an altar* → *congratulate*; *celebrate*; *commemorate*.
祭主贊詞者。从示从人口。一曰从兌省。《易》曰：“兌爲口爲巫。”。

As per 申# (bolt of lightning) + 示 altar/the supernatural → supernatural force associated with lightning/thunder → *mysterious power*; *God*; *god* → *mind*; *supreme* → *ancestor*; *soul of the dead*. In the dual-element characters 榊 and 鰰, 神 appears in variant form.
天神，引出萬物者也。从示、申。
示 altar/the supernatural + 出# protrude → emergence/appearance of evil spirits → *evils/ills* → *curse*; *haunt*; *punishment*.
神禍也。从示从出。
司# administer + 示 altar/the supernatural → altar of an ancestral temple at which rites are administered → (small) *shrine*; *worship*; *offer prayers*.
春祭曰祠。品物少，多文詞也。从示司聲。仲春之月，祠不用犧牲，用圭璧及皮幣。
燒祡燓燎以祭天神。从示此聲。《虞書》曰：“至于岱宗，祡。”
As per 羊# (abundant) + 示 altar/the supernatural → propitious *omen* of abundance to come → *happiness*.
福也。从示羊聲。一云善。
As per 兆# (split) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *building for worshiping ancestors*, set apart from a mausoleum.
遷廟也。从示兆聲。

Originally, an abbreviated form# of 要 (compress) + 火 fire → fine/light particles that rise from an object compressed by flames → *slip*; *ballot*; *vote* (← tiny pieces of paper or wood used as tickets or for balloting). 火 was later replaced with 示 altar/the supernatural.
祔、祪，祖也。从示危聲。

As per 合# (press/fit together) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *commemorate ancestors jointly* (i.e. a *festival* in which ancestors both proximate and distant in the bloodline are jointly commemorated).
大合祭先祖親疏遠近也。从示、合。《周禮》曰：“三歲一祫。”

The top element was originally an abbreviated form# of 刷 scrape away impurities. 祭 adds 示 altar/the supernatural → purify unclean meat by scraping away impurities and making an offering of it → *offer prayers*; *worship*; *festival* → *event*.
祭祀也。从示，以手持肉。
告祭也。从示从告聲。
精氣感祥。从示，㑴省聲。《春秋傳》曰：“見赤黑之𥛆。”
社肉，盛以蜃，故謂之祳。天子所以親遺同姓。从示辰聲。《春秋傳》曰：“石尚來歸祳。”
宗廟奏祴樂。从示戒聲。

其 here an abbreviated form# of 期 (one full agricultural cycle) + 示 altar/the supernatural → full/abundant blessings from the gods (compare 福 with this same meaning), such as manifested in a rich harvest → *fortunate*; *free of worry*. For the connection between abundance and (good) fortune, compare also 吉.
吉也。从示其聲。
果# fruit + 示 altar/the supernatural → nectar libation offered in a *ceremonial invocation of the gods*.
灌祭也。从示果聲。
福也。从示彔聲。
林# forest + 示 altar/the supernatural → sanctified ground contained within a forest, access to which is prohibited → *prohibition*; *abstain*; *rule*.
吉凶之忌也。从示林聲。
禱牲馬祭也。从示周聲。《詩》曰：“旣禡旣禂。”
As per 契# (separate) + 示 altar/the supernatural → become pure in separating oneself from things unclean → *purify oneself* → *purification ceremony*.
垔 here an abbreviated form# of 煙 smoke + 示 altar/the supernatural → smoke accompanying a *sacrifice* → *offer/make a sacrifice*.
潔祀也。一曰精意以享爲禋。从示垔聲。
咼# (variant of 冎 round or rounded cavity) + 示 altar/the supernatural → have the *misfortune* to fall into a hole (compare 俗 and 凶) → *catastrophe*.
害也，神不福也。从示咼聲。
As per 貞# (upright) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *happiness* bestowed on those whose behavior is upright/*correct*.
祥也。从示貞聲。
As per 畐# as described in 副 (abundance) + 示 altar/the supernatural → abundant blessings from the gods/heaven → *blessing*; *wealth*; (good) *fortune*.
祐也。从示畐聲。
道上祭。从示昜聲。
As per 是# (straight) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *good fortune* bestowed by the heavens upon one whose behavior is straight/*correct* (compare the same idea in 禎) → *truly* (← true ← correct).
安福也。从示是聲。《易》曰：“禔旣平。”

As per 某# (abundance) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *god of childbearing*; (imperial) *ritual/prayers for the conception of a child* (in particular, a male child/heir). The term is also connected with the beneficial effect of plums (the original sense of 某) for pregnant women; compare 梅.
祭也。从示某聲。
帝# emperor + 示 altar/the supernatural → ritual/sacrifice pertaining to the emperor → *festival*.
諦祭也。从示帝聲。《周禮》曰：“五歲一禘。”
以眞受福也。从示眞聲。
設緜蕝爲營，以禳風雨、雪霜、水旱、癘疫於日月星辰山川也。从示，榮省聲。一曰禜、衞，使灾不生。《禮記》曰：“雩，禜。祭水旱。”
福也。从示虒聲。
師行所止，恐有慢其神，下而祀之曰禡。从示馬聲。《周禮》曰：“禡於所征之地。”
As per 御# (whip) + 示 altar/the supernatural → festival/ceremony held to drive off evil → *ward off*; *resist*; *block*; *defend*.
祀也。从示御聲。

禦.explanation: 禦 is used for defending, resisting, or warding off; 御 remains for imperial and certain control senses.
禦.example: 抵御 → 抵禦; 御用 → 御用
禦.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 喜# joy + 示 altar/the supernatural → *good fortune*; *blessings*; *auspicious augur*; *congratulations* (← good fortune/blessings of supernatural origin) .
禮吉也。从示喜聲。
幾 here an abbreviated form# of 機 opportunity + 示 altar/the supernatural → *omen* of good fortune.
單# single + 示 altar/the supernatural → meditation resulting in metaphysical unity. *Zen (Buddhism)* is via a transliteration of the Sanskrit dhyana (meditation).
祭天也。从示單聲。
除服祭也。从示覃聲。
會福祭也。从示从會，會亦聲。《周禮》曰：“禬之祝號。”

The relevant seal inscription form of the right-hand element is 豆 food stand + grain piled atop in an orderly arrangement. 禮 adds 示 altar/the supernatural → well-ordered, lengthy ritual → *propriety* → *salutation*. Distinguish the right-hand element in this character from the independent character 豊, which is a Shinjitai (new character form) of 豐.
履也。所以事神致福也。从示从豊，豊亦聲。
As per 爾# (adhere) + 示 altar/the supernatural → memorial tablet dedicated to one's father, and adhering to an altar → *ancestral shrine*.
親廟也。从示爾聲。一本云古文𥜬也。
壽# long span + 示 altar/the supernatural → prolonged *entreaty/prayer* → *pray*.
告事求福也。从示壽聲。
Abbreviated form# of 攘 repel + 示 altar/the supernatural → *exorcise* (← repel unclean spirits) → *purification* ceremony; *sacrifice*.
磔禳祀，除癘殃也。古者燧人禜子所造。从示襄聲。
以事類祭天神。从示類聲。

A depiction of an animal, seen from the rear. The meaning *trample* suggests the original notion was that of a beast softening earth in trampling it; compare the Old Chinese homonym 蹂 (also "trample").
獸足蹂地也。象形，九聲。《尔疋》曰：“狐貍貛貉醜，其足𨆌，其迹厹。”凡厹之屬皆从厹。
Originally, a depiction of a winding, serpentine creature. 禹王 refers to the legendary founder of the Shang Dynasty. Distinguish 禹 and 兎 rabbit.
蟲也。从厹，象形。
A depiction of a *monkey* with both a curved back and a curved tail.
母猴屬。頭似鬼。从甶从禸。
A variant of 廌 odd beast → odd, horned beast → *rare beast*; *strange*.
山神，獸也。从禽頭，从厹从屮。歐陽喬說：离，猛獸也。
蟲也。从厹，象形。讀與偰同。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is as per 今# (contain) + a net with a handle → contain (birds) in a net in capturing (compare 罕) → *capture*; (captive) *bird* → *captive*. A seal inscription form adds a depiction of an animal's buttocks.
走獸緫名。从厹，象形，今聲。禽、离、兕頭相似。
A depiction of a round head of millet hanging low on its stalk → *grain* → *rice*.
嘉穀也。二月始生，八月而孰，得時之中，故謂之禾。禾，木也。木王而生，金王而死。从木，从𠂹省。𠂹象其穗。凡禾之屬皆从禾。

An abbreviated form# of 冗 (open space) + 禾 (round) grain/rice → plenteous open space on the forehead (as a result of hair loss) → *be/grow bald*. Also, a type of *short-cropped hairstyle worn by children* → *young servant girl at a brothel*.
無髮也。从人，上象禾粟之形，取其聲。凡禿之屬皆从禿。王育說：蒼頡出見禿人伏禾中，因以制字。未知其審。
As per 乃# (soft and clingy) + 禾 grain/rice → clinging ears of grain curving upward and surpassing shorter ears → *surpass* → *excel*; *superior*; *prominent* (← be high).
上諱。漢光武帝名也。
厶# possession + 禾 grain/rice → divide harvested crops and take possession of one's own share → *self*; *private*; *first person pronoun* → *selfishness*; *family*; *private ownership*; *secret*.
禾也。从禾厶聲。北道名禾主人曰私主人。
壅禾本。从禾子聲。
二秭爲秅。从禾乇聲。《周禮》曰：“二百四十斤爲秉。四秉曰筥，十筥曰稯，十稯曰秅，四百秉爲一秅。”

禾 grain/rice + an abbreviated form# of 爭 (tug on a long, thin object) → take crops firmly in hand in tugging on them to harvest → *take/hold firmly in the hand* → *unit of volume* (← weight of harvested crops). Also, *authority* (← take power in hand ← take in hand).
禾束也。从又持禾。
穀孰也。从禾千聲。《春秋傳》曰：“大有秊。”

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 禾 grain/rice + 束 bundle → bundle and compact/shrink harvested crops in *autumn*/*fall*. The character was later reinterpreted, as shown by a seal inscription form that is 禾 plus an element combining 火 fire and 龜 turtle → dry and shrink the size of harvested crops (as turtle meat is dried over a fire; compare 焦). The present form repositions 禾 and 火 while eliminating 龜. Note also the variant form 龝, which combines 禾 and 龜.
禾穀孰也。从禾，𤒅省聲。

鞦.explanation: 鞦 is used in the traditional spelling 鞦韆 (swing); 秋 meaning autumn remains 秋.
鞦.example: 秋千 → 鞦韆; 秋天 → 秋天
鞦.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 稻屬。从禾毛聲。伊尹曰：“飯之美者，玄山之禾，南海之秏。”
禾# grain/rice + 斗 ladle → determine the quality/grade of crops in weighing them → *rank*; *examine* → *course*; *section*; *department* (← places where examinations are carried out; compare 課).
程也。从禾从斗。斗者，量也。
As per 少# (small/slight) + 禾 grain/rice → small *tip* of grain → *very small* → *second* (← small unit of time).
禾芒也。从禾少聲。
As per 亢# (stretch) + 禾 grain/rice → taut, non-glutinous *rice*. 秔 and 粳 convey the same term.
稻屬。从禾亢聲。
比# line up + 禾 grain/rice → *devoid of grain* (← husks neatly aligned but devoid from the outset of grain) → *bad*. 秕 and 粃 are effectively variant forms of each other.
不成粟也。从禾比聲。

祕 is as per 必# (split) + 示 altar/the supernatural → *mysterious*/*secret* ritual involving actual/figurative and permanent splitting. 秘, which substitutes 禾 grain/rice for 示, is a variant form that has supplanted 祕. The use of 禾 may owe to connections with harvest rituals.
稻今秊落，來秊自生，謂之秜。从禾尼聲。
稀疏適也。从二禾。凡秝之屬皆从秝。讀若歷。
As per 且# (pile) + 禾 grain/rice → *levy*/*tithe*, originally paid with (piles of) harvested crops. Compare 税.
田賦也。从禾且聲。
一稃二米。从禾丕聲。《詩》曰：“誕降嘉穀，惟秬惟秠。”天賜后稷之嘉穀也。
As per 末# (minute) + 禾 grain/rice → minute pieces of *feed/fodder* for horses/livestock.
禾 grain/rice + 平# (spread level/flat) → spread crops flat/level in weighing them → *weigh*; *steelyard*; (weighing) *scale*. Also, *measure* and *gauge*.
禾 grain/rice + an abbreviated form# of 舂 pound → pound grain into fine pieces. *Qin Dynasty* (221-206 B.C.E.) is a borrowed meaning.
伯益之後所封國。地宜禾。从禾，舂省。一曰秦，禾名。
As per 央# (stretch) + 禾 grain/rice → (rice) *seedling* stretching energetically skyward.
禾若秧穰也。从禾央聲。
禾搖皃。从禾乍聲。讀若昨。
禾 grain/rice + 失, here an abbreviated form# of 迭 rotation → rotate crops → *sequence*; *order*.
積也。从禾失聲。《詩》曰：“䆅之秩秩。”
朮# foxtail millet + 禾 grain/rice (for emphasis/clarification) → *glutinous millet*.
稷之黏者。从禾；术，象形。
As per 巨# (great/large) + 禾 grain/rice → large variety of grain → *black millet*. Compare 粔.
五稯爲秭。从禾𠂔聲。一曰數億至萬曰秭。
舂𥻆不漬也。从禾𠯑聲。
多# much/many + 禾 grain/rice → *move*/*transfer* numerous grain plants → *change* (← change positions).
禾相倚移也。从禾多聲。一曰禾名。
